symptom: A mapping's `with xml schema Module.NoSuchThing` is accepted by `mxcli check`, by `check --references` AND by `exec`, and the build fails with **CE1613** "The selected XML schema 'X' no longer exists" at the import/export mapping. The JSON twin's fix (ako/mxcli#259 first half) left the same hole at `check -p`
cause: The reference was written to BSON verbatim; nothing listed XML schemas, so nothing could resolve it. The JSON half refused only in the executor's create path, which `check` never reaches — `check --references` runs `validateWithContext`, a different switch
file: `sdk/mpr/reader_types.go` (`ListXmlSchemas`), `mdl/backend/mapping.go` + `mpr`/`modelsdk`/`mock` impls, `mdl/executor/mapping_customhandler.go` (`resolveXmlSchemaSource`, exec tier), `mdl/executor/validate_mapping_sources.go` (check tier, covers BOTH schema kinds)
insight: **A corpus grep said there was no reference document; it was wrong, and HOW it was wrong is the lesson.** `grep -rl "XmlSchemas" <extracted app>` returned 0 for all 9 demo apps, but that can only work for **MPR v2**, where units are files under `mprcontents/`. The one app that HAS them (OneHarness, 3 documents) is **MPR v1**: its units live in the SQLite `Unit.Contents` blob and are not greppable from the file. The grep silently answered "does any file contain this string" instead of "does any project contain this document" and returned 0 for a reason unrelated to the question. Read units through `mprbson.units()` or the reader, never by grepping the tree. Corrected numbers: 3 XML schemas in 1 of 9 apps, vs 36 message-definition collections and 250 JSON-backed mappings. The synthetic-unit measurement below stands, and the reader is now also verified against those 3 real documents.** PLANT a synthetic unit instead and let mxbuild identify it: a temporary `_test.go` in `sdk/mpr` calling `AddRawUnit(id, moduleID, "Documents", "XmlSchemas$XmlSchema", …)` with `{Name, Documentation, Excluded, ExportLevel, Entries, FilePath}` moved the mapping's error from CE1613 "no longer exists" to **CE0292 "Please import an XSD file." at XML schema 'XGap.Probe_Xsd'** — mxbuild naming, by module and name, the document it had just found. That is the whole proof of both the `$Type` string and the `Name` key, and it agrees with `modelsdk/gen/xmlschemas`'s codec registration and `gen/mappings/refs.go`'s `Target`. **FAIL OPEN on an empty list**: with no `create xml schema` and only 1 of 9 apps holding any, an empty list is the ordinary case, so refusing on it would break every XML mapping to catch nothing — and a wrong `$Type` would then degrade to today's behaviour rather than a regression. Match on the **qualified** name; a bare-name match accepts `A.Foo` because `B.Foo` exists, which is the dangling reference all over again. Fix the check tier by adding a validator beside `validateIconRefs` (same class: "MxBuild otherwise reports the typo as CE1613") rather than a `scriptContext` field — a script that creates a structure then maps over it is the commonest shape and must not be flagged. ako/mxcli#259
